visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dimly lit indoor parking garage or staging area. A woman with long reddish-brown hair in pigtails, wearing a white padded jacket, holds a camera in a selfie position. She is smiling broadly, showing her teeth. Behind her, rows of parked scooters and concrete walls are visible. (2) She is joined by another woman with black hair wearing a white and maroon Rakuten baseball jersey, holding a blue cup and a handheld gimbal camera. They walk through the corridor, laughing and gesturing towards each other. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor daylight setting on the top deck of an open-top bus. The first woman is seen waving energetically to a massive crowd lining the streets below and on overhead walkways. The sky is overcast and grey. (4) Several other women in matching baseball jerseys and black skirts are on the bus, dancing, waving, and filming the crowds with smartphones and action cameras. One woman points playfully at another who is holding her camera at a funny angle. (5) The bus moves through a busy urban street. Large groups of fans are seen on the sidewalks, some on scooters, many waving flags and wearing team colors. Banners and red lanterns are visible on the buildings. (6) A large red monkey mascot in a baseball uniform is visible inside a glass-walled float or trailer. A hand with red-painted nails reaches out to touch the glass, and the mascot waves back as the vehicle pulls away down the street.
